entries.content: API must use REST over GraphQL
API must not use REST; GraphQL is preferred
Application uses React 19 for UI components
Primary database is PostgreSQL 15 running on AWS RDS
CI pipeline uses GitHub Actions with macos-latest runners
Authentication uses JWT tokens with 30 expiry
Application is deployed on Azure in ap-southeast-1 region
Node.js version 22 is required per .nvmrc
Logging uses Winston with error as default level
Package manager is pnpm with lockfile package-lock.json
API gateway is AWS API Gateway handling rate limiting at 500 req/s
Feature flags managed via Flagsmith with 15 active flags
Use TypeScript strict mode across all packages
Adopt pnpm workspaces for monorepo management
Prefer function components over class components
Use eslint with prettier for code formatting
Store secrets in Vault not in environment files
Use a single staging environment shared by all teams
Adopt trunk-based development with short-lived branches
Use date-based versioning (YYYY.MM.MINOR)
Prefer webp over PNG for all new image assets
Enforce 80 char line width in all source files
Commit messages follow conventional commits format
File names use kebab-case for everything
Export public API from index.ts barrel files
Always write unit tests for new modules
Use named exports not default exports
Document public APIs with JSDoc
Prefix interface names with I (e.g. IConfig)
Use const assertions for literal types
Order imports: node → external → internal
Environment variables use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE
Memory leak in session manager when events arrive out of order
Race condition in file lock acquisition under concurrent access
Token estimator underestimates code-heavy payloads by 40%
JSONL store corrupts entries containing unicode surrogate pairs
FTS5 query with special characters throws unhandled exception
Compact operation drops entries when rewriteAll overlaps kinds
MCP tool selection crashes on null description field
Summary cache invalidation returns stale results for renamed files
Reverse import resolution circular dependency causes stack overflow
SupraSpace sync writes managed blocks into wrong file sections
Core package must have zero runtime dependencies on OpenCode
All public APIs must be versioned and backward compatible for min 2 releases
No secrets may be logged or persisted in plaintext
Context payload must fit within 16000 token budget
File ownership lock must expire after 120 seconds
All storage writes must be atomic (no partial file writes)
Memory retrieval must be deterministic with same inputs
Plugin must support both JSONL and SQLite storage backends
Maximum single entry content length is 8000 characters
Task plans must detect and warn about duplicate work
Add session heartbeat recovery: all E2E pass (12/12)
Implement FTS5 BM25 rank blending: recall@5 improved from 0.65 to 0.82
Migrate config from v1 to v2 shape: all migrations green
Add Unicode support to token estimator: coverage verified on 20 languages
Performance audit: reduce context build latency by 35%
Add stale-evidence sweep: 142 stale entries cleaned in prod
Update README with MCP protocol v2 examples
Fix regressions in ownership fencing token generation
Add SupraSpace vault projection: 87 memory entries mapped
Remove deprecated direct-opencode integration path
Docker image is hosted on Docker Hub (migrated to ECR)
Use Webpack for bundling (migrated to esbuild)
Server runs on CentOS 7 (migrated to Ubuntu 24.04)
Use mocha + chai for testing (migrated to node:test)
Legacy note about using MySQL for analytics cache
Use jQuery for DOM manipulation (no longer used)
API rate limit was 100 req/min (updated to 1000 req/min)
Production used t2.micro instances (upgraded to t3.large)
Tab indentation was standard (now spaces)
Sass for styling (now CSS modules)
System handles 100k concurrent users (disputed: load test shows 50k max)
Use Redis for session store (disputed: some services use in-memory)
Imported claim about last.fm API integration pending review
Unreviewed proposal to adopt Biome over eslint+prettier
Agent-submitted observation about WebSocket reconnect behavior
Candidate decision to move from REST to GraphQL
Claim: PostgreSQL 17 uses 30% less memory (unverified)
Proposal: commit messages in Chinese (pending team vote)
Config file sets log level to debug (evidence file changed)
CI pipeline runs on push to main (evidence file changed)
Dockerfile uses node:18 base image (evidence file changed)
Application supports 日本語, 中文, 한국어, русский язык, العربية
Día de los Muertos holiday feature uses emoji 🎉 and accented characters
Unicode normalization form NFC is used for all user input été vs ete
Gödel's incompleteness theorem reference in architecture doc
Café menu feature uses é, ñ, ü characters throughout
Function getUserData was renamed to fetchUserProfile in v2.1
Class DBConnection renamed to DatabaseConnector
File src/utils/helpers.ts moved to src/lib/utilities.ts
Config key database.port changed to db.connection.port
Environment var DB_HOST renamed to DATABASE_HOST
